subject.title: fix(tools): route sessions_send announcements back to requester channel for non-plugin transports

question: Should requester-resolved sessions_send A2A delivery become terminal after the first visible primary reply, or must normal peer sends preserve the configured ping-pong/announce path with a non-deadlocking design?
rationale: Current docs and integration coverage describe bounded peer follow-up turns, while the PR fixes the requester-channel drop by returning before that path whenever requesterTarget resolves.

options.title: Preserve peer follow-up
options.body: Require the PR to deliver the first reply to the requester while still honoring the documented maxPingPongTurns/announce contract through a non-deadlocking design.

options.title: Accept terminal direct delivery
options.body: Treat requester-channel primary delivery as the new end state, then update tests/docs/proof so the changed contract is explicit before merge.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Hold the branch until the sessions_send owner decides whether the existing A2A follow-up behavior is worth preserving.

recommendation.title: Preserve peer follow-up
recommendation.body: Require the PR to deliver the first reply to the requester while still honoring the documented maxPingPongTurns/announce contract through a non-deadlocking design.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle appears in recent sessions docs and announce-target history that define the current sessions_send contract.
